docs.shape: mesh = its triangles (to walk on; physics collides a mesh as its box, PhysX's rule for a dynamic body, and eidosim carries boxes), box = its bounding box, sphere = a ball (rolls, under an engine that carries spheres); remove the component to let its size decide
docs.enabled: false: not solid. Nothing collides with it, stands on it or bumps into it (walkers, agents, the authority's track, the physics engine); it still moves as its physics.kind and motion say, and is still drawn, clicked and grabbed

absentMeans.speaker: no stage cue: the caption bot uses its own speaker

absentMeans.pos: it turns and scales about its origin, [0, 0, 0]

absentMeans.decay: 1.7: the falloff exponent the light rig used before it was written (three.js decay); a value stored before 10-16 is repaired to 1.7 at its first load

Today that shape is its measured bounding box, so a chair weighs as a solid box of its density; eidosim's flight computes the same (shared/sim.js: 1000 kg/m³ × its box) and reads no mass yet. Never a constant

absentMeans.restitution: 0..1; absent, its surface's, else the engine's own law (eidosim: its fixed bounce)

absentMeans.restitutionCombine: average|min|multiply|max, as frictionCombine; absent, its surface's, else max
absentMeans.linearDamping: 1/s; absent, the engine's own law (eidosim: none)
absentMeans.angularDamping: 1/s; absent, the engine's own law (eidosim: none; it doesn't spin)

docs.kind: dynamic (falls, tumbles, can be pushed) | static (never moves) | kinematic (moves only by its motion, an edit or a script, pushes others; what the authority stamps on a thing with motion or openable) | none (not simulated: the engine never moves it). Whether it is solid is collider.enabled's, never the kind's
